heading: Scope
text:
### Scope [LNLS.2.6]

The extension is program-scoped per [LDIA.2.9].  A project may mix
`linear_scan: false` programs with others.  A `linear_scan: false` program
may import schemas from any library provided the imported
schemas comply with [LNLS.3.1] (no `json` slots) when used in a
`linear_scan: false` rule.
